data.description:
# Wire disk-backed TMPDIR + stale-root prune into the test runner

Parent: SA-0MW2QED9M005FWOK (disk-backed TMPDIR + stale pytest-root prune)
Depends on: F1 (shared `skill/shared/test_tmpdir.py` helper)

## Goal

Make the test runner (`skill/test/scripts/run_tests.py`) pass a disk-backed
`TMPDIR` to every suite command it spawns and prune stale pytest roots before
a full-suite run, without changing any suite command string, cache key or
scope resolution.

## Existing state (verified)

- Every suite command is spawned by `_run_cmd()` with
  `env=_suite_command_env()`; `_suite_command_env()` layers
  `test_runner.subprocess_env_with_scrubbed_overrides()` and
  `VITEST_MAX_WORKERS`. That helper is the single insertion point for
  `TMPDIR` — the scrub touches only repository overrides, so `TMPDIR` passes
  through untouched today and is simply never set.
- The full-scope path resolves commands inside `run_all(...)` (the
  `if commands is None` branch, `resolvable_scope = "full"`); the prune hook
  belongs there (or in `guarded_run_all` before `run_all`), so it runs at
  least for full scope.

## Targeted outcome

- `_suite_command_env()` sets `TMPDIR` from
  `shared.test_tmpdir.resolve_test_tmpdir()` (the helper from F1), logging at
  INFO when a disk-backed dir is chosen and at DEBUG/WARNING when a candidate
  is unusable.
- The full-scope entry path calls
  `shared.test_tmpdir.prune_stale_test_roots()` before executing, logging the
  removed count + freed paths at INFO.
- Both calls are fail-open: any helper error is logged and the run proceeds
  unchanged.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `_suite_command_env()` sets a disk-backed `TMPDIR` on the child env for
      every suite command; a unit test asserts the env handed to the spawned
      command carries the resolved TMPDIR, and covers the fallback path when
      no disk-backed candidate exists.
- [ ] The full-scope path invokes the stale-root prune before execution; a
      unit test asserts the prune is invoked for full scope (and that a
      changed-scope run does not regress command selection).
- [ ] Fail-open is proven by a test that forces the TMPDIR resolver and the
      prune helper to raise and asserts the run's exit status, cache entry and
      scope resolution are unchanged (log only).
- [ ] Suite command strings, cache keys and changed/full scope resolution are
      byte-identical (env-only change); a regression test pins the command
      string / cache key.
- [ ] Logging uses INFO for a chosen disk-backed TMPDIR and for pruned roots,
      DEBUG/WARNING for an unusable candidate.

- [ ] No behaviour change to test selection or caching: changed/full scope
      resolution, cache keys and the audit-accepted full-suite cache entry
      are unchanged (the TMPDIR/prune work is env-only and does not alter
      any suite command string).

## Minimal implementation

- Import the F1 helpers in `run_tests.py`.
- In `_suite_command_env()`: resolve TMPDIR once (module-level cache is
  acceptable) and set `env["TMPDIR"]`.
- In `guarded_run_all()` (before `run_all`) or the full-scope branch of
  `run_all`: call the prune when the resolved scope is full.
- Add `skill/test/tests/test_run_tests_tmpdir.py` and
  `skill/test/tests/test_prune_stale_test_roots.py`.
- Never rewrite a command string; never alter cache key derivation.

## Key files

- `skill/test/scripts/run_tests.py` — `_suite_command_env` + full-scope prune hook + logging
- `skill/test/tests/test_run_tests_tmpdir.py` (new)
- `skill/test/tests/test_prune_stale_test_roots.py` (new)

## Dependencies

- F1 (helper module + unit tests).

## Risky assumptions

- `_suite_command_env()` is the only child-env construction path for suite
  commands (verified: `_run_cmd()` is the single spawn point).
- Pruning before a changed-scope run is unnecessary; full scope is the
  churn-heavy path the bug reported.
